question: With reference to the Major Port Authorities Bill passed in 2021, what is the TAMP?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tariff Authority for Major Ports.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Major Port Authorities Bill 2020**, seeks to replace the **Major Port Trusts Act of 1963**.
 
• **Rajya Sabha **passed the Major Port Authorities Bill, 2020 on **10 February 2021**.
 
• The **Lok Sabha **passed the bill on** September 23, 2020**.
 
• The** Bill aims** to provide for the **regulation, operation, and planning of Major Ports **in India and to vest the administration, control, and management of such ports upon** the Boards of Major Port Authorities.**
 
• **The new act** has proposed a simplified composition of the **Board of Port Authority** which will comprise **11 to 13 Members.**
 
• It will help India become a** global manufacturing and trading hub **
